column1: golang fibonacci function iterative implementation in Go, function takes int n returns int, write the function and show fibonacci(10) output

Implement a Go HTTP endpoint that handles POST requests at path /users, reads a JSON body with name and email string fields, validates both are present and non-empty, responds with HTTP 201 and the user object as JSON or HTTP 400 with an error. Use only the standard library.

Write a Go function that opens a JSON config file at a given file path, decodes it into a struct with Host string Port int Debug bool fields, and wraps any file or decode errors using fmt.Errorf with percent-w for error chain support.

Implement a Validate method on a Go User struct. The method should return an error if Name is empty, if Email does not contain an at-sign, or if Age is outside the range 0 to 150. Return a descriptive message for each case.
golang iterative factorial function: func Factorial(n int) int using a for loop, plus a main that prints Factorial(10)

Create a Go HTTP handler for POST /products. The request body is JSON with title string and price float64. Validate title not empty and price positive. Return 201 with product JSON on success, 400 with error message on failure. No external packages.
Go function that loads a JSON file from disk into a map[string]interface{}, wrapping every error with fmt.Errorf and the %w verb. Return the map and error.

Add a Validate method to a Go Product struct with Title string, Price float64, SKU string. Validation rules: Title non-empty, Price > 0, SKU must match pattern of three uppercase letters, a dash, and four digits. Return descriptive errors.
Write a binary search function in Go: func BinarySearch(arr []int, target int) int — returns index or -1. Add a main function that searches for 42 in a sorted integer slice.
Go HTTP GET handler for /users that returns a JSON array. Support limit (default 10 max 100) and offset (default 0) query params. User struct has ID int, Name string, Email string fields.

Go function that reads environment variables DB_HOST, DB_PORT as int, DB_NAME (all required) and DB_SSL as optional bool defaulting to false. Returns a DBConfig struct. Wraps missing variable errors with fmt.Errorf.

Add Validate to a Go Order struct. Check CustomerID is nonzero, Items slice is nonempty, each item has Quantity above zero and UnitPrice non-negative, and TotalAmount equals the computed sum. Collect and return all errors.
